about_me_info_section.subTitle: TECH · DESIGN · VISIBILITY
about_me_info_section.title: Digital Solutions from a Single Source
about_me_info_section.description:
For several years, I have been designing and developing websites and digital applications. Since 2026 I have been working independently as a freelancer, combining my passion for technology with creativity. Thanks to my experience across different areas, I support projects with a broad understanding — from the initial consultation and concept through to implementation and the finished digital product. Straightforward, precise, and all from a single source.

Through my practical agency experience in software development, media design, and search engine optimization, I don't want to limit myself to a single discipline, but rather combine these areas in a meaningful way. It's exactly this interplay that makes my work exciting and enables solutions where technology, design, and visibility are considered together from the very start.

about_me_section.title: About Me
about_me_section.name: Lena Zyadeh, BSc.
about_me_section.description:
I am a freelance web and app developer specializing in React, Next.js, and Flutter.

I started my career at Marqably, a digital agency in Vienna, where I spent two years building and maintaining several digital products — including apps with hundreds of thousands of active users. That experience shaped the standards I hold my work to: clean code, proper documentation, and a working style that doesn't need hand-holding.

Now working independently, I take on projects where both sides matter — a strong sense for design, and the technical depth to execute it properly.
